access.description: Grafana provisioning defaults to proxy access. The editor has no access selector and plugin queries run on the backend.

basicAuth.description: Enable this only when the OpenTSDB endpoint requires HTTP Basic authentication. It defaults to false. TLS settings and custom HTTP headers work independently of Basic auth.

basicAuthUser.description: Username to send when HTTP Basic authentication is enabled. Omit it for connections without Basic auth.

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Route requests through the secure SOCKS proxy configured on the Grafana instance. In Grafana Cloud, set secureSocksProxyUsername to the selected PDC private network ID.

httpHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers sent to OpenTSDB. Provision each name as jsonData.httpHeaderName1, httpHeaderName2, and so on. Store each matching value in secureJsonData.httpHeaderValue1, httpHeaderValue2, and so on.

keepAlive.description: TCP keep-alive interval in whole seconds for the SOCKS proxy connection. Zero uses the Go dialer default. A negative value disables keep-alive probes.

keepCookies.description: Cookie names Grafana passes to the plugin. The OpenTSDB backend HTTP client does not forward those cookies to the server.

lookupLimit.description: Maximum results for suggestions and tag-value lookups, as a nonnegative whole number. Zero or an omitted limit sends 1000 for suggestions and 0 for tag-value lookups. Set 1000 explicitly to use it for both. Tag-key lookups always request 1000.

oauthPassThru.description: Pass the signed-in user's OAuth identity from Grafana to the plugin. The OpenTSDB backend HTTP client does not forward it to the server.

secureSocksProxyUsername.description: In Grafana Cloud, supply the selected PDC private network ID. For a self-managed SOCKS proxy, supply its username or omit it to use the data source UID.

serverName.description: Optional hostname used for TLS certificate verification and SNI. The editor shows it with TLS Client Auth. Provisioning also accepts it with a custom CA alone.

timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in whole seconds. Zero removes the request timeout.

tlsAuth.description: Validate using TLS client authentication, in which the server authenticates the client

tlsAuthWithCACert.description: Verify the server certificate with a custom certificate authority.

tlsSkipVerify.description: Skip verification of the OpenTSDB server certificate and hostname.

tsdbResolution.description: The editor stores 1 for seconds or 2 for milliseconds. This setting has no effect on current queries, which request and read timestamps in seconds.

tsdbVersion.description: Select the OpenTSDB release to set query editor features and the response format. Use 1 for 2.1 or earlier, 2 for 2.2, 3 for 2.3, or 4 for 2.4.

url.description: Base HTTP or HTTPS URL of the OpenTSDB server, including its port. The plugin appends the API path.

withCredentials.description: Sets the credentials flag on legacy browser HTTP requests. Backend queries use the plugin HTTP client.

secureValues.description: Password to send when HTTP Basic authentication is enabled. Omit it for connections without Basic auth.
PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the server.
PEM-encoded client certificate used for mTLS. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ClientCertificate`.
PEM-encoded private key paired with `tlsClientCert`. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ClientKey`.
Password for a self-managed SOCKS proxy if it requires one.
